name: Uncoated (CR)
notes: Reference baseline. For interior / covered parts only.

name: Galvanized (HDG, pure Zn)
notes: Widely used. Zinc vapor at laser weld requires gap/brazing control.

name: Galvannealed (Zn-Fe)
notes: Better RSW current range and paint adhesion than GI.

name: Electrogalvanized
notes: Preferred for class-A outer panels (surface quality).

name: Zn-Al-Mg (ZM)
notes: 2–3x corrosion life vs GI at equal mass. Enables thinner coating.

name: Al-Si (Usibor-class, for PHS)
notes: Required for uncoated-style PHS to prevent scale; requires laser ablation before LWB welding.
source: WorldAutoSteel AHSS Insights, Al-Si coatings for PHS

name: Zn-coated PHS
notes: Cathodic protection after paint bake, but needs indirect/2-step PHS route to avoid LME.
